master.sql: SELECT m.GOODSID, m.GOODSNAME, m.DTL_USEFLAG, m.FACTORYNAME, m.PRICE, m.GOODSNO, m.PGOODSID, m.PGOODSNO, m.APEX_PL, m.BATCH_QTY FROM (SELECT a.GOODSID, b.GOODSNAME, b.USEFLAG DTL_USEFLAG, b.FACTORYNAME, a.PRICE, (SELECT g.GOODSNO FROM CMX.T_COST_GOODS g WHERE g.GOODSID = b.GOODSID) GOODSNO, d.GOODSID PGOODSID, (SELECT g.GOODSNO FROM CMX.T_COST_GOODS g WHERE g.GOODSID = d.GOODSID) PGOODSNO, d.GOODSNAME PGOODSNAME, c.APEX_PL, a.BATCH_QTY FROM T_COST_PINGGU_DTL a, T_COST_GOODS b, T_COST_PINGGU c, T_COST_GOODS d WHERE a.GOODSID = b.GOODSID AND a.DOCID = c.DOCID AND c.GOODSID = d.GOODSID) m
